text_block_list.text:
Starting today is the "Summer Training Camp"—
Intensive training to improve skills begins.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Well then, Trainer-san!
Shall we go drop off our luggage too?♪

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Don't '...Huh?' me!
Just get over here already!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...Phew, secured the meeting spot.
Heh-heh. Looks like we're the first ones here.
choice_data_list: Did you want to be the first one here?
I wanted to be the first one here.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Dummy, that's not it.
I mean, sure, being 'number one' in anything feels great, but...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I can't exactly have a serious chat with you
where all the other girls can hear, can I?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
If you understand, then let's quickly make a plan!
Since we're here, we have to make the most of this environment!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
There's a lights-out time, but no curfew.
Running until the dead of night sounds great, too.
choice_data_list: I won't push you too hard, okay?
I won't push you too hard.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"...Yeah, yeah.
You sure act like a Trainer at times like this."

And so, Summer Training Camp with
Daiwa Scarlet has begun!!
